name: Lido EarnUSD
oneLiner: earnUSD is Lido's Mellow-curated dollar-strategy share; returns compound into NAV, with queued USDC withdrawals and a conditional instant USDC rail.
collateral: Lido/Mellow earnUSD MetaVault allocates across earnUSDc (conservative) and earnUSDe (experimental) underlying vaults. The official interface discloses lending, structured positions, liquidity provision and leverage risk. USDC, USDT and USDe are registered deposit assets, not measured reserve weights; current whole-book holdings, gearing and encumbrances remain unreconciled.
pegMechanism: Returns compound into vault shares through privileged oracle reports. Ordinary USDC withdrawals use a non-cancellable request-and-claim queue, typically about three days. A separate synchronous USDC rail is conditional on usable oracle pricing, liquidity and rolling-limit headroom. Neither the typical wait nor the interface's 'instant or up to 72 hours' description establishes guaranteed completion under stress.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum share token is a BurnableTokenizedShareManager proxy for vault 0x014e6da8f283c4af65b2aa0f201438680a004452. At block 26196064 (2026-10-15T06:16:59Z), totalSupply is 55763458395796490454989108 raw with 18 decimals, vault.subvaults() is 2 and all six decoded share flags are zero. Its verified ABI implements modular vault-share accounting, not ERC-4626 asset()/totalAssets(). Returns depend on underlying strategies and internal oracle reports; ordinary exits use queued USDC claims, with a separate conditional synchronous rail. This protocol-position override does not establish legal segregation, current look-through allocations or independent financial reconciliation. The March 7 creation transaction is deployment provenance; Lido announced the product live on March 12.

notices.title: Interface eligibility restrictions
notices.message: Lido's September 23, 2026 terms exclude Lido Earn access or deposits from U.S. and UK citizens or residents and users accessing from those countries. The linked strategist terms separately restrict vault use to professional or business capacity, not consumers. See the linked terms for the full eligibility conditions.
